references.text: Parallel account of Jesus giving thanks and distributing bread and fish to the crowd, with an identical sequence of actions.
Synchronized account where Jesus takes bread, blesses it, breaks it, and gives it to the disciples to distribute.
Parallel account of another miracle where Jesus takes bread, gives thanks (eucharisteō), and distributes it to the crowd, using the same wording for the action.
The risen Jesus takes bread, blesses it, breaks it, and gives it to the disciples, recreating the same liturgical action.
A prophetic precursor describing God satisfying the hungry with good things, a theme fulfilled in this miracle.
